profile.title: Your account

hero.lead: Someone recognises the cat on your street faster than any shelter database will. This is a board for that, and for the shelters rehoming the animals nobody came back for. Moderated before anything goes public.

sections.howLead: Three steps, and a moderator between every listing and the public page.
sections.stepOneBody: A photo and a spot on the map. No name and no number: whoever recognises the animal writes to you through the site.
sections.stepTwoBody: Every listing waits in a queue. Nothing reaches the public map before somebody has looked at the photo.
sections.stepThreeBody: The listing shows on the map for the neighbourhood it belongs to, and a message reaches you by email.
